severity_score: modified SOFA (5 of 6 systems; cardiovascular capped at 1, CNS omitted)
caveat: The severity score is deliberately weakened by missing vasopressors and GCS, and bilirubin is absent for most patients so the liver component scores 0 by default. All of that biases the comparison in ENDOTYPE's favour, so the null is stronger than it appears, not weaker.
second_caveat: Every AUC here is near 0.5. Neither endotype nor severity predicts sepsis onset well, so this compares two weak predictors. The limiting factor is the endpoint — a 6h-shifted Sepsis-3 label, not an outcome these subphenotypes were built to predict. Report both halves or the finding is misleading.
